description: Java service class that categorizes documents based on heuristics applied to OCR text and title.

classes.name: CategorizationService
classes.description: A service class that provides document categorization functionality using simple keyword heuristics.

methods.name: autoCategorize
methods.description: Categorizes a document as Transportation, Lodging, Travel, Meals, Office Supplies, General, or Uncategorized based on keywords in title and OCR text.
